design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The caller asks one ordinary thing - close my hotel bill off and tell me what comes off my card before I go. Nothing in that sentence names a figure, and nothing in it says the folio is three lines short. The desk capability it forces out is exactly the one a hotel agent needs at a corporate checkout: read a folio line by line and notice that a stay of six nights carries only five room nights, that the sixth night is untaxed, and that this morning's breakfast has never been posted; price each of those three from the plan, the records and the company contract; and only then work out what the guest actually settles, on a folio that the agent has itself just completed. Every one of the three prerequisites is visible only in the arithmetic of the records against the policy - never in what the customer says - and the root figure is wrong unless all three are posted first and posted correctly. The difficulty is in reading and calculating, not in choosing among tools: there are exactly four writes available and each is named by exactly one policy.

SCOPE: ALREADY OCCUPIED / THIS TASK / STILL TO COME. Task 0 occupied the property-credit pair - stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant and stay_ext_departure_credit_release, on the subjects stay_resort_credit_grant and stay_resort_credit_use, with the tools post_arrival_credit_grant_b81202b7 and apply_property_credit_f4ca2b6a. This task claims four policies with no overlap of any kind: stay_ext_closing_night_charge (subject stay_room_charge, tool post_closing_room_night_00233ccc), stay_ext_closing_tax_charge (subject stay_tax_and_fee_charge, tool post_closing_tax_charge_e4008804), stay_ext_closing_breakfast_charge (subject stay_incidental_charge, tool post_closing_breakfast_charge_10224aa5) and stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement (subject stay_check_out, tool settle_departure_folio_3e89900b). This is the last task of the difficulty, so nothing is reserved; the six policies of the two tasks are pairwise disjoint and together are every extended policy the charter declares. Base ground left untouched by both tasks - cancellation, no-show, refund settlement, best-rate settlement, modification and property-notice relocation - is claimed by neither and is therefore free of any obligation this suite must carry.

THE STEP 0 DRAW, AS PRINTED. `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0000_online_travel_agency/tasks/hotel_reservations_desk --tasks 2` prints for this task: {"task": 1, "key": "online_travel_agency/hotel_reservations_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 4, 4]}. The tree therefore has exactly three prerequisite problems, and the four computations carry 6, 4, 4 and 4 factors. stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement took the count 6; the three postings took 4 each. The design was fitted to those numbers, not the other way round.

THE PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root problem: stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement, the problem the caller's request points at. Prerequisite problems: stay_ext_closing_night_charge, stay_ext_closing_tax_charge and stay_ext_closing_breakfast_charge. Four edges, all value_input, which is above the floor of max(3-1, 1) = 2.
  EDGE 1, stay_ext_closing_tax_charge <- stay_ext_closing_night_charge. gate: closing_room_charge, a compute binding of the blocked policy. form: state. Prerequisite sentence, quoted from the blocked policy's own rule: "The closing tax charge is worked out only after the room night for the last night of the stay stands on the folio." Four-point test: (1) "only after" joins this policy's own result to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state - a room night for the last night of the stay standing on the folio - in the words the folio finder uses, naming no action and no performer; (3) no tool, policy id, snake_case token or row id; (4) "only after" is a hard requirement matching the edge condition exactly, naming the last night and no other. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: stay_ext_closing_night_charge is the only policy of the charter whose subject is stay_room_charge and whose target tool creates a room-night line. Derivation: the sentence says the tax waits on the last night's room charge; the folio read at action 3 shows room nights for 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-15 against a reservation running to 2026-09-17, so the state does not hold; the other policy's rule opens "The closing night charge is the room rate posted for the last night of a stay" and is the only rule that says what posts a room night; so exactly one action follows.
  EDGE 2, stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement <- stay_ext_closing_night_charge. gate: room_total. form: state. Sentence: "The closing folio balance is settled only once the room nights standing on the folio cover every night of the stay." Four-point test: "only once" is the ordering connective; the XX side is the record-visible state of the room nights covering every night; no code token; the strength is hard and the scope is every night, no wider and no narrower.
  EDGE 3, stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement <- stay_ext_closing_tax_charge. gate: tax_total. form: state. Sentence: "Before the closing folio balance is worked out, the statutory charge for the last night of the stay must stand on the folio." "Before ... must" is the connective and the strength; the XX side is a record-visible statutory charge; the only write of this difficulty that raises one is stay_ext_closing_tax_charge.
  EDGE 4, stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement <- stay_ext_closing_breakfast_charge. gate: breakfast_total. form: state. Sentence: "The closing folio balance is fixed only after the folio carries the breakfast owed for the departure morning." "only after" is the connective; the XX side is a record-visible breakfast line for a named morning; the only write of this difficulty that posts breakfast is stay_ext_closing_breakfast_charge.
  No edge uses the action form, so no fallback_reason is declared anywhere; a record-visible state carried every one of the four.
  SEED EVIDENCE THAT EACH EDGE IS FALSE AT THE OPENING. Edges 1 and 2: initial_state.stay_reservations.<res>.nights_count = 6 and check_out_date = 2026-09-17, while the latest room-night line on the folio carries stay_date = 2026-09-15; no folio row has charge_category room_night and stay_date 2026-09-16. Edge 3: the latest occupancy_tax line carries stay_date = 2026-09-15 and no folio row carries a statutory charge for 2026-09-16. Edge 4: the only two breakfast lines carry stay_date 2026-09-12 and 2026-09-15, and none carries 2026-09-17.
  TOPOLOGICAL ORDER: stay_ext_closing_night_charge, stay_ext_closing_tax_charge, stay_ext_closing_breakfast_charge, stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement - the gold write nodes at action indices 7, 9, 11 and 13 in that order.
  PARALLEL EDGES AND THEIR UNAMBIGUITY: see prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness. The breakfast posting is parallel to the other two and the Step 5 run proves both orders give the identical terminal database (hash equality printed by the harness) and identical scored parameters, because the breakfast policy reads only breakfast lines, the stay dates, the occupancy declared and the corporate programme, while the other two read only room nights, occupancy supplements, the property notice and the programme. The room-night and statutory postings are not parallel: an edge orders them.
  DELETION SENSITIVITY, ACTUALLY RUN: see prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing. 47.43 becomes 48.12 without the room night; 1008.95 becomes 1021.45, 989.97 and 956.31 without the room night, the statutory charge and the breakfast respectively.
  THE PERSONA MENTIONS NO PREREQUISITE, AND NO TOOL BLOCKS ONE: see prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint and tools_do_not_block.

WHY THE OWNER=USER WRITE IS GENUINELY THE CUSTOMER'S. Closing the folio settles the balance on the card standing in the guest's own name, which is why the tool is owner=user and why the agent unlocks it at action 12 and hands it over rather than running it. It completes inside the one frozen time: the call moves the reservation to departed, stamps the date and records the settled figure, with nothing to wait for. The persona carries the boundary in her own words - the desk may act for her on the property's side of the account, but she wants to be the one who closes the folio because it is her card the balance lands on.

THE BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write 1, subject stay_room_charge. Three base policies govern it and none has an eligibility gate that applies to that subject, so all three are carried as policy_scope: stay_agg_portfolio_occupancy (each reservation priced on its own terms, extra-occupant charges counted per room), stay_room_and_occupancy (the rate posted night by night and room by room; the occupancy declared at booking is what the room is priced for - three adults on a plan whose standard occupancy is two) and stay_club_and_corporate_interaction (a corporate programme reference means the negotiated rate stands alone). Write 2, subject stay_tax_and_fee_charge: stay_taxes_and_fees alone, policy_scope, tax following the night stayed. Write 3, subject stay_incidental_charge: stay_incidentals with the real gate stay_in_progress - "An optional extra taken during the stay is posted only while the reservation record stands at checked in or checked out" - satisfied because initial_state.stay_reservations.<res>.status reads checked_in, correlated to the call by stay_reservation_id exactly as the gate's evidence_contract.action_bindings prescribes; plus stay_club_and_corporate_interaction at policy_scope. POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE CASES for that gate: on this world the status reads checked_in and the gate holds; had the folio already been closed to departed the gate would still hold, since it admits checked out, but had the reservation been cancelled or a no-show it would fail and the breakfast could not be posted at all - which is why the breakfast must be posted before the folio is closed rather than after the guest has gone. Write 4, subject stay_check_out: stay_incidentals alone; its gate applies to stay_incidental_charge only, so the precondition is policy_scope. There is no time eligibility on any of the four writes, so temporal_feasibility is [] and no anchor, counting rule or boundary is inherited.

THE BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is the single Denver reservation on the Semi-Flexible Rate, correlation key stay_reservations.stay_reservation_id; every folio aggregate is scoped to it. Rows included: the closing rate averages only the five charge_category=room_night lines; the taxable base takes the latest room-night line by posted date, which after the first write is the one just posted; the average room night divides the room-night total by the room-night count; the breakfast rate and basis take only the charge_category=breakfast lines; the settled charges take room_night, occupancy_tax, resort_fee, parking, extra_occupant, breakfast and agency_service_fee, each by its own category. Rows deliberately excluded and why: the property notice carries no money and, since it is posted with no charge category at all, enters none of the seven category sums; the deposit of 342.00 is charge_category deposit and is set against the settled charges rather than counted among them, which the rule says in terms; the occupancy supplements are charge_category extra_occupant on the stay_room_charge event, so they are settled charges but never room nights; and on the corporate side the subscription line of 449.00 fails the hotel-booking-fee filter while the hotel booking fee of 2025-06-11 falls outside the twelve-month window. Each of the three postings writes back the reservation reference and the exact night or morning it covers, so no later reader has to infer which object a line belongs to.

THE FACTOR CARD - stay_ext_closing_night_charge (4 factors: 3 parameter, 1 method).
  closing_rate_basis (method). Ladder: a property notice on the folio AND room nights posted at or above the busy stay nights of 5 -> the average of the room nights posted; a property notice AND fewer than 5 -> the highest room night posted; otherwise -> the latest room night posted. Tier taken: the first, on notice DEN204-N7731 and five posted nights; the average is 1604.00 / 5 = 320.80. Evidence rows: the five room-night lines and the notice line. Baseline: the latest room night, 289.00, which gives 255.60 against gold 283.73. The three tiers are three different ways of measuring the same quantity - a mean, a maximum and a last value - not one formula with a number swapped, and the business reason is real: where the property has itself moved the guest mid-stay, the closing night follows what she actually paid across the stay rather than the reduced rate she happens to be on at the end.
  corporate_rate_reduction (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on biz). Ladder: an active programme whose negotiated hotel discount is at or above the preferred discount floor of 8 -> that programme's own discount; an active programme whose discount is below that floor AND whose hotel booking fees over twelve months reach the hotel fee floor of 18 -> the standard corporate discount of 3 per cent; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, on Business Pro's 5 per cent and 22.50 of hotel booking fees. Evidence rows: the biz_programs row and the five hotel-booking-fee lines of the biz ledger. Baseline nil, giving 292.50. NEAR-MISS: the subscription line of 449.00 would swamp the twelve-month figure for anyone who reads "billed to the programme" as all billing, and the hotel booking fee posted 2025-06-11 sits just outside the window; the rule names both exclusions.
  stay_length_reduction (parameter). Ladder: 7 nights or more -> 12 per cent; 4 or more -> 6 per cent; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, six nights. Baseline nil, giving 301.84.
  advance_booking_reduction (parameter). Ladder: 45 days or more between booking and arrival -> 7 per cent; 14 or more -> 3 per cent; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, 33 days. Baseline nil, giving 292.51.
  WHOLE-BASELINE FALL-BACK: 289.00, differing from gold.
THE FACTOR CARD - stay_ext_closing_tax_charge (4 factors: 3 parameter, 1 method).
  taxable_base_basis (method). Ladder: an occupancy supplement on the folio AND six nights or more -> the closing room charge together with the plan's occupancy supplement; an occupancy supplement AND fewer than six nights -> the closing room charge together with the plan's facility fee and parking for the night; otherwise -> the closing room charge alone. Tier taken: the first, giving 283.73 + 35.00 = 318.73. Baseline: the room charge alone, giving 42.88. Whether an occupancy supplement or a mandatory fee is itself taxable is a genuine difference between lodging-tax regimes, not a number swapped in one formula.
  occupancy_rate_band (parameter). Ladder: closing room charge at or above 320 -> 14 per cent; at or above 250 -> 13 per cent; otherwise the plan's own 12.5 per cent. Tier taken: the second, on 283.73. Baseline 12.5 per cent, giving 45.84. A lodging tax banded by the nightly rate is a real and common statutory shape.
  city_levy_band (parameter). Ladder: average room night at or above 400 -> 18.00; at or above 250 -> 12.00; otherwise 7.00. Tier taken: the second, on 314.62. Baseline 7.00, giving 42.43. NEAR-MISS: the seeded city levy is a flat banded amount and not four per cent of the room charge, so an agent who applies the base percentage reaches 11.35 rather than 12.00; the extended rule declares the change and the seeded nights carry the banded figure.
  corporate_tax_exemption (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on biz). Ladder: duty-of-care cover AND five hotel booking lines or more -> 6.00; duty-of-care cover AND two or more -> 3.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the first, on five in-window lines. Baseline nil, giving 53.43.
  WHOLE-BASELINE FALL-BACK: 42.47, differing from gold 47.43.
THE FACTOR CARD - stay_ext_closing_breakfast_charge (4 factors: 3 parameter, 1 method).
  breakfast_rate_tier (parameter). Ladder: breakfast already standing at or above 60 -> 18.00; at or above 40 -> 21.00; otherwise the plan's 24.00. Tier taken: the second, on 48.00 already standing. Baseline 24.00, giving 56.00.
  breakfast_charge_basis (method). Ladder: two breakfast lines or more AND more adults than the standard occupancy -> the rate charged for every adult declared; two or more AND the standard occupancy or fewer -> the room breakfast amount taken once for the room; otherwise -> the rate for the lead guest alone. Tier taken: the first, three adults declared, giving 21.00 x 3 = 63.00. Baseline: the lead guest alone, giving 5.00. Whether breakfast is charged per head or per room is a real and visible difference between properties, and the unit of charge changes, not a rate inside it.
  breakfast_length_relief (parameter). Ladder: 7 nights or more -> 12.00; 4 or more -> 6.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second. Baseline nil, giving 53.00.
  programme_meal_allowance (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on biz). Ladder: expense integration included AND eight hotel booking lines or more -> 20.00; expense integration AND three or more -> 10.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, on five in-window lines. Baseline nil, giving 57.00.
  WHOLE-BASELINE FALL-BACK: 24.00, differing from gold 47.00.
THE FACTOR CARD - stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement (6 factors: 5 parameter, 1 method).
  direct_bill_share (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on biz). Ladder: an active programme whose credit limit is at or above 250,000 -> 100 per cent; at or above 50,000 and below that -> 60 per cent; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, Business Pro's limit being 75,000. Baseline nil, giving 2459.59. Direct billing extended up to the contracted credit limit is exactly how corporate lodging accounts work.
  direct_bill_scope (method, multi-source, cross-difficulty on biz). Ladder: consolidated invoicing AND six room nights or more -> room, tax and facility fee; consolidated invoicing AND fewer -> room and tax; otherwise -> room alone. Tier taken: the first, giving a base of 2417.74. Baseline: room alone, giving 1326.95. What a company is invoiced for as against what the traveller settles is a scope, not a rate.
  property_notice_goodwill (parameter). Ladder: a property notice AND six nights or more -> 120.00; a property notice AND fewer -> 60.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the first. Baseline nil, giving 1128.95.
  service_fee_waiver (parameter). Ladder: eight facility-fee nights or more -> 14.95; three or more -> 7.50; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, six nights. Baseline nil, giving 1016.45.
  departure_service_charge_rate (parameter). Ladder: five on-site extras or more -> 18 per cent; two or more -> 12 per cent; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, three extras once the breakfast is posted. Baseline nil, giving 997.55. This is the only factor that adds rather than subtracts.
  parking_rebate_tier (parameter). Ladder: six parking nights or more -> 48.00; three or more -> 24.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the first. Baseline nil, giving 1056.95.
  WHOLE-BASELINE FALL-BACK: 2623.69, differing from gold 1008.95 by more than a factor of two - an agent who finds only the four computation documents settles the guest for two and a half thousand dollars.
  This customer sits off the fall-through of all eighteen declared factors, so every one of them bites. Four of the eighteen read the corporate programme, and they read four different things from it - the negotiated hotel discount, the duty-of-care cover, the expense integration and the credit limit with consolidated invoicing. That is not one condition repeated: a corporate lodging contract really does carry a rate discount, a tax exemption, a meal allowance and a direct-billing arrangement as separately negotiated lines, and each decides a different quantity here.

WHICH BASE BOUNDARIES ARE INHERITED, AND WHAT IS OVERRIDDEN. Everything not named in an overwrite stays in force and is relied on: the room rate posted night by night and room by room; the occupancy declared at booking being what the room is priced for; the extra-adult supplement charged for every night the occupant stays, counted per room; the facility fee charged per room per night on a plan that does not waive it; parking charged per room per night and never where no vehicle is declared; breakfast charged per person per day on a plan that does not include it; an extra posted only while the reservation stands at checked in or checked out; and a corporate reference meaning the negotiated rate stands alone with no club discount on top. Three clauses are superseded, each declared sentence by sentence. stay_ext_closing_night_charge supersedes "The room rate is posted night by night and room by room, at the rate the plan was sold at, and a rate once sold is never re-priced because the property's published rate has moved", because on this world base would post 289.00 or 342.00 and the extended policy posts 283.73 - the measurement basis and the reductions are what change, and the plan's own parameters remain base's numbers. stay_ext_closing_tax_charge supersedes "Occupancy tax and city tax are applied to the room total alone, night by night, and never to optional extras or to the agency service fee", because it carries the two on one line and admits the occupancy supplement into the taxable base. stay_ext_departure_folio_settlement supersedes "At departure the folio is closed off: every posted line is settled against the deposit already held and the balance is taken from or returned to the card on file", because the balance recorded at departure is net of what the programme is billed, the goodwill given and the waivers made, rather than the plain sum less the deposit. That last override is also why the folio balance the reservation carries after the fourth write, 1008.95, is the settled figure rather than the arithmetic sum of the money lines: the charter's own stay_check_out event names folio_balance_usd as the field that write sets, and the extended rule says what figure goes in it. Before that write the seeded value, 2929.53, is exactly the sum of the money lines. No second product law was created: every factor reads a plan parameter, a base charter asset or the records.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS, AND WHAT WOULD CHANGE WITHOUT IT. The five room-night lines at two different rates carry the closing rate, the average room night and the room total; flatten them to one rate and the average, the maximum and the latest coincide and closing_rate_basis becomes decoration. The sixth night's absence is edges 1 and 2. The six facility-fee lines carry the service fee waiver and enter both the settled charges and the direct billed base; drop three and the waiver falls from 7.50 to nil. The six parking lines carry the parking rebate; drop one and it falls from 48.00 to 24.00. The six occupancy supplements carry the taxable base tier and 210.00 of settled charges. The five statutory lines carry 272.58 of settled charges and show which night is untaxed. The two breakfast lines set the breakfast rate to 21.00 rather than 24.00 and the charge basis to the busy tier; the departure morning's absence is edge 4. The deposit of 342.00 is the money the property took at confirmation and is the only line set against the balance rather than added to it. The agency service fee of 14.95 is the amount the waiver is measured against. The property notice puts both closing_rate_basis and property_notice_goodwill on their first tiers. On the corporate side the programme row decides four tiers, five ledger lines carry the twelve-month figures, and two lines exist only to be excluded.
AUTOMATIC-CLAUSE CHECK. Base's automatic consequences on a checked_in reservation are the room nights posted from check-in, the taxes and mandatory fees owed on those nights, and any property credit the plan carries. The Semi-Flexible Rate grants no property credit at all (its credit amount is zero), so no grant is owed and none is seeded - which is also why this task cannot collide with task 0's subjects. The room nights, facility fees, parking and occupancy supplements are seeded complete for the booked stay except for the one closing night, and the statutory charges except for that night, and the breakfast except for the departure morning: those three absences are precisely the obligations this task discharges. Nothing else is lit - no cancellation or no-show status, no approved relocation behind the property notice (so stay_evt_property_notice owes no allowance and none is posted), no refund payout, no best-rate claim, and no unsettled status that a later reader would have to clear. CACHE CHECK: no cache trap is designed here; folio_balance_usd at the opening is exactly the sum of the money lines and resort_credit_balance_usd is 0.00 on a plan that grants none.

THE PERSONA. Priya Raghunathan is written as a brisk consultant with a flight to catch and the folio in front of her; the register is clipped and practical, quite unlike the unhurried guest of task 0, and the information arrives in the order a hurried caller gives it - the request, then the authorisation boundary, then identity only on request, then the details about her colleagues, the car park and this morning's breakfast only when asked. What she volunteers: that she is checking out today, that the firm books through a corporate programme, and that she wants the folio closed off and the figure worked out before she goes; the authorisation she gives is a bare permission for the desk to act on the property's side, naming nothing that is outstanding. All three are entailed by the opening world: the reservation stands at checked_in with a departure date of 2026-09-17 and carries a corporate programme reference. What she gives only on request: her name, the number held against the booking, her date of birth, the last four of her passport, the company name, how many shared the room, that she used the car park, that she had breakfast this morning, and that she cannot find the confirmation number. What she reacts to rather than initiates: she says fine, thank you when told something has been brought up to date, and she runs the closing step only after the agent has explained it and handed it to her. Natural traps: she offers the company name but no programme reference, so the agent must look it up rather than guess; and she cannot produce the confirmation number, so the booking must be found from her own details. She has no figure of her own and the persona says in terms that she settles what she is given, so she can neither confirm nor contradict a wrong answer. The ending closes exactly where evaluation_criteria closes: the last thing she does is close the folio and thank the agent, and she asks for nothing beyond it - the one courtesy about an emailed folio is answered with "nothing else", so it creates no work outside gold.

THE PREREQUISITE CHAIN THE AGENT MUST DISCOVER, AND WHY IT CANNOT BE REORDERED. Surface goal (close the folio and tell me what I settle) -> the settlement rule, which says the balance is settled only once the room nights cover every night, only after the statutory charge for the last night stands, and only after the departure morning's breakfast is on the folio -> the folio, which shows five nights against six, five statutory lines against six nights, and two breakfasts none of which is this morning's -> the three rules that say what posts a room night, a statutory charge and a breakfast -> and, among those three, a further edge: the statutory charge is worked out only after the last night's room charge stands, because it is measured against it. DEPTH is two hops on the longest path (room night -> statutory charge -> settlement); BREADTH is three prerequisites converging on one root, each drawing on its own evidence: the closing night charge on the room-night history, the notice, the stay dates, the booking date and two corporate reads; the statutory charge on the latest room night, the supplements, the average night and two more corporate reads; the breakfast on the breakfast history, the declared occupancy and two more; and the settlement on seven separate category sums, the deposit, the notice, the facility, parking and extra counts and two further corporate reads. Reordering the first two is impossible - taking the tax first gives 48.12 - and the settlement must come last or three of its inputs are short.

WHERE A CARELESS AGENT GOES WRONG, AND HOW THE POLICY EXCLUDES IT. Taking the latest room night as the closing rate when a property notice stands (the first tier of closing_rate_basis says the average). Counting the subscription line into the programme's hotel booking fees, or counting the line posted more than twelve months back (the rule names both exclusions). Taxing the room charge alone when the folio carries occupancy supplements (the first tier of taxable_base_basis). Applying base's four per cent city tax instead of the banded levy (the extended rule declares the change and the seeded nights carry the band). Charging breakfast for the lead guest alone when three adults are declared (the first tier of breakfast_charge_basis). Counting the deposit among the settled charges instead of setting it against them (the rule says in terms that it is not one of them). Charging the guest for what the programme is billed for (the direct billed amount is subtracted). Closing the folio before the three postings, which gives 2623.69 at worst and 956.31, 989.97 or 1021.45 for each single omission. Every one of these is decided by a sentence of the published rule.

THE STANDARD SOLUTION. Find the traveller by name and telephone number; verify with date of birth and passport last four. Read the reservation: Semi-Flexible Rate, checked_in, 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-17, one room, three adults, booked 2026-08-09, corporate programme referenced. Read the folio: five room nights (342.00 x 3, 289.00 x 2), six facility fees at 35.00, five statutory lines, six parking at 38.00, six occupancy supplements at 35.00, two breakfasts at 24.00, one deposit of 342.00, one agency service fee of 14.95 and one property notice. Read the programme (Business Pro, active) and its ledger (five in-window hotel booking fees of 4.50, one subscription, one out-of-window fee). Post the closing night: average 320.80, less 3 per cent, less 6 per cent, less 3 per cent, in that order and rounding at each step, giving 283.73 for 2026-09-16. Post the closing statutory charge for the same night: base 318.73 at 13 per cent is 41.43, plus the 12.00 levy, less the 6.00 exemption, giving 47.43. Post the departure morning's breakfast: 21.00 for each of three adults is 63.00, less 6.00 relief and 10.00 allowance, giving 47.00 for 2026-09-17. Then hand the closing step to the guest: settled charges 2965.69, less 1450.64 billed to the programme, less the 342.00 deposit, less 120.00 goodwill, less 7.50 service fee waiver, less 48.00 parking rebate, plus 11.40 service charge, giving 1008.95.

user_scenario:
Priya Raghunathan runs the transport practice at a nine-person advisory firm in Seattle and has spent the last week in Denver on a rail study, sharing a room with two colleagues because the client budget is what it is. She is brisk on the phone, used to reading invoices, and she has the folio open on the desk in front of her. It is a little after ten and she is due at the airport: she wants the room bill closed off and to know what actually comes off her card before she hands the keys back, and she would like it settled this morning rather than left to appear on a statement later. She puts it in her own words: she is checking out of the Denver hotel today, the firm books through its corporate travel programme, and she wants the folio closed off and the figure she settles worked out before she leaves.

She has never had to think about how the company's programme and the room bill fit together and does not pretend to. She has no figure of her own and says so if asked what she expects to pay; she will accept whatever the desk works out and put it through. The desk may act for her on the property's side of the account, she says when asked, and she leaves it at that. Closing the folio itself she wants to do herself, because it is her card the balance lands on, so when the agent has that step ready and hands it over she will run it and read the confirmation back.

Asked who is calling, she gives her name as Priya Raghunathan. If the agent asks for a number held against the booking she reads out 4692558103, which is also the number on the firm's programme. If asked her date of birth she gives 1987-11-30, and if asked for the last four of her passport she gives 1338. She cannot find the confirmation number on the folio printout and says so if pressed, asking the desk to pull the booking up from her own details instead. If the agent asks for the company programme she says it is under Meridian Line Advisory and that her colleague in accounts handles the invoices, but she does not know any reference number for it and suggests the agent look it up.

Two colleagues shared the room with her all six nights, and she confirms that if the agent asks how many of them were in the room. She confirms, if asked, that she took the hire car and used the hotel car park every night, and that she had breakfast downstairs this morning before packing. If she is asked whether she wants anything emailed she says the folio to her work address is fine and nothing else.

She does not push the conversation along. Whenever the agent tells her something has been brought up to date on the folio she says fine, thank you, and waits for the next thing. When the agent explains what the closing figure comes to and hands her the step to close the folio, she runs it and reads back the confirmation. Once she has done that and heard the reservation is recorded as departed, she thanks the agent, says that is the bill sorted and she can get to the airport, and rings off. If the agent leaves something off the folio or hands her the wrong figure she has no way of telling and does not argue; she settles what she is given and goes.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the closing tax charge is posted, the statutory charges total this policy reads rises to 320.01 and the direct billed base with it.

edges.condition: The folio carries the breakfast owed for the departure morning.
edges.policy_source: The closing folio balance is fixed only after the folio carries the breakfast owed for the departure morning.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The folio carries breakfast only for 2026-09-12 and 2026-09-15. No breakfast line stands for the departure morning of 2026-09-17, so the breakfast total reads 48.00 and the on-site extras number two rather than three.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the closing breakfast charge is posted, the breakfast total this policy reads rises to 95.00 and the departure service charge taken on it rises with it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Two of the three prerequisites are ordered by an edge of their own: the closing tax charge waits on the closing night charge, so those two can only be taken in that order, and the verification run confirms it from the other side - taking the tax first gives 48.12 rather than 47.43. The closing breakfast charge is genuinely parallel to both, and the Step 5 run proves the two orders leave everything identical: running the breakfast first and then the room night and the statutory charge gives a terminal database whose hash equals the hash of the gold order (printed as 'hash(D1 first) == hash(D1 last): True'), and every scored parameter is unchanged - the closing night charge evaluates to 283.73 with the breakfast posted first as well as last, the closing tax charge to 47.43, and the closing breakfast charge to 47.00 on the opening world as well as after the other two. That is so because the breakfast policy reads only breakfast lines, the stay dates, the occupancy declared and the corporate programme, none of which the room-night or statutory writes touch, while the room-night and statutory policies read only room nights, occupancy supplements, the property notice and the programme, which the breakfast write does not touch.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the closing night charge and replaying the rest unchanged leaves the latest room night on the folio at the 289.00 charged for 2026-09-15, so the taxable base falls from 318.73 to 324.00, the average room night from 314.62 to 320.80 and the closing tax charge computes as 48.12 instead of 47.43.

Skipping the closing night charge leaves the room nights total at 1604.00 instead of 1887.73 and the direct billed base at 2134.01 instead of 2417.74, and the closing folio balance computes as 1021.45 instead of 1008.95.

Skipping the closing tax charge leaves the statutory charges total at 272.58 instead of 320.01 and the direct billed base at 2370.31 instead of 2417.74, and the closing folio balance computes as 989.97 instead of 1008.95.

Skipping the closing breakfast charge leaves the breakfast total at 48.00 instead of 95.00 and the departure service charge at 5.76 instead of 11.40, and the closing folio balance computes as 956.31 instead of 1008.95.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona never mentions the missing room night, the untaxed night or the unposted breakfast, and never says that anything is missing from the folio. She asks only for the folio to be closed off and the figure she settles worked out, which is the root problem, and says in terms that she has no figure of her own and will accept whatever the desk works out. She does say she had breakfast this morning, but only when the agent asks whether she did - it is an answer a real agent must obtain before charging a meal, not a prompt, and she volunteers nothing about it and never suggests it should be on the bill. Nothing she says names any of the three prerequisite problems or the writes that resolve them; her only contribution to them is passive, saying fine, thank you when told something has been brought up to date.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four tools in task_tools.py validates a prerequisite. post_closing_tax_charge_e4008804 performs one ctx.create of the statutory line; it reads the reservation only to copy the customer reference and the folio only to number the line, defaulting to an empty string when the reservation is not found, and it never tests whether a room night stands for that date, never raises and never returns an error. settle_departure_folio_3e89900b performs one ctx.update of the reservation and reads nothing at all, so it will close a folio whose last night is unposted, untaxed and without its breakfast just as faithfully as a complete one. Called out of order the tools still write, and the only consequence of skipping a prerequisite shows up in the terminal hash.
